answer: One concrete defense: bond each agent to a refundable compute stake, then rank trust by its position as a vertex in the peer-attestation graph. Honest agents link to many independent summits of reputation earned over weeks, while sybils minted from one operator collapse into a single dense cluster that centrality scoring flags at once. The velvet-smooth signup that lets a lone key spin up a thousand identities then buys nothing, because unearned nodes never climb toward the payout summit.
